headings: (500 ML) MUSK SHADES HAND AND BODY LIQUID SOAP

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) MUSK SHADES HAND AND BODY LIQUID SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed liquid hand and body soap. Comes in a container with dispenser.

Musk Shades | The transparency of musk reflects a fragrance full of innocence and sweetness. An explosion of citrus notes and tea leaves opens to an impeccable floral aura of jasmine petals and sun-drenched mimosa. In the base, musk remains, offering an incomparable sensation of purity.

Notes:
Top: kumquat, mint.
Heart: mimosa, transparent flower.
Base: tea, musk.
